rooms.title: Rooms
rooms.description: Pick the areas to protect. Each one gets its own step next.

room.title: Room: {room}
room.description: Pre-filled from the areas of your entities and devices; check it. In an outdoor room, motion, person detection, lights and contacts only mean someone is outside, and power sensors are not used. Occupancy strength comes from the device class (occupancy and presence are strong, motion medium, sound weak, Bayesian sensors strong) and can be changed later in Configure. An occupancy source with 'person' in its name is camera person detection, the strongest source. {remaining} room(s) to go.

data.interior_doors: Fridge, cabinet, drawer and closet contacts

house.title: Whole house
house.description: Each resident's device trackers are read from their person entity. At night, outdoor rules count 1.5 times, and a house whose family or guests are in bed is watched much like an empty one. With residents home, it is night while the bedtime sensor is on or the alarm panel is armed night; either one counts, and SIEM only reads them. The night window stands in when neither is picked or one is unavailable. With only guests home the night window decides, and the bedtime sensor or panel saying bed can only make it night sooner; with nobody home the night window decides alone. [Why each setting is here]({docs_url}).

data.guest_trackers: Guests' device trackers: home means guest mode
data.water_flow: Water flow sensor on the main supply
data.automated_loads: Power sensors of loads that run on their own (EV charger, heat pump)
data.lcm_events: Lock Code Manager 'credential used' event entities
data.guest_sensors: Guest sensors: on means guest mode
data.service_sensors: Service sensors: on means service mode
data.alarm_panel: Alarm panel: armed night means everyone is in bed
data.asleep_sensor: Bedtime sensor: on means everyone is in bed

data_description.guest_sensors: Binary sensors, helpers or schedules. Any one on means guest mode, the same as a 'Guest:' event, and either the calendar or a sensor is enough. Guest mode lasts two hours after it turns off, and until the house has been quiet for an hour.
data_description.service_sensors: Binary sensors, helpers or schedules, such as a workday sensor for the cleaners' days. Any one on means service mode, the same as a 'Service:' event, and either the calendar or a sensor is enough. A workday sensor is on all day; a schedule can cover just their hours.
data_description.night_start: Your household's usual night hours. They decide night with only guests or nobody home, and stand in for the bedtime sensor and alarm panel with residents home when neither is picked or one is unavailable. The recommended alarm mode follows them. At night, outdoor rules count 1.5 times.

csi_map.title: Wi-Fi motion sensors and doors
csi_map.description: For each Wi-Fi motion sensor, pick the contact on the same door. Motion there with no door opening within 60 seconds scores door_csi_motion.

responses.title: Digest
responses.description: SIEM never acts on its own: it keeps its state in entities and fires a siem_notification event for every alert, and your automations decide what happens (see the blueprints and packages). The digest summarises each day's incidents, written by an AI task entity when you pick one.

label_incident.name: Label incident
label_incident.description: Label an incident. False alarm lowers the weights of its rules by 10% (to no less than 0.3) and real raises them by 10% (to no more than 1.5); that's me and guest are recorded and leave the weights alone.

label.name: Label
label.description: False alarm, that's me, guest or real.

incident_id.name: Incident id
incident_id.description: Defaults to the open or most recent incident.

run_digest.name: Run digest
run_digest.description: Write the digest for everything since the previous one now, send it, and return it.

ai_task_entity.name: AI task
ai_task_entity.description: Write this digest with another AI task than the configured one, to compare models.

preview.name: Preview
preview.description: Only return the digest: don't send it, and don't start a new digest period, so the same stretch can be written again.

set_house_mode.name: Set house mode
set_house_mode.description: Force a house mode, or auto to derive it again. A forced mode survives restarts.
